name: bode/module-metrics
description: OpenTelemetry metrics for Magento 2 with a hard low-cardinality contract: HTTP, cron, indexers, queues, cache, outbound HTTP and a state collector. A no-op without ext-opentelemetry.

suggest.ext-opentelemetry: Required at runtime for the hooks that time requests, jobs and calls
suggest.open-telemetry/exporter-otlp: Required to export metrics over OTLP
